statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit across six representative routes/conditions. The age-verification provider handoff was not submitted because it requires real user identity; the on-site gate itself was fully inspected.

page.notes: Public adult-content site with a jurisdictional age-verification gate on the homepage, browse/localized routes, contact form, legal content, sitemap, and standalone web manifest. Detail/media pages were not available from the gated initial response; category/listing, form, legal, locale, and error archetypes were sampled instead.

paths.description: Homepage and legally required age-verification entry flow; represents the global header, navigation, safety gate, and initial-load experience.
Tags/listing route selected to represent browse/index templates. The route returned homepage-equivalent metadata/content, which is itself recorded as an issue.
Contact form selected as the primary authored form and validation/recovery journey.
Privacy notice selected as the long-form legal/content template.
French locale selected to test translated-route language and bidirectional/internationalisation readiness.
Synthetic missing URL selected to inspect HTTP failure handling.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s light/dark preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot and computed DOM are unchanged; root color-scheme is normal and the CSS probe found zero prefers-color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme at document and root level and drive surface/text tokens from prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Reduced-motion users still receive dozens of infinite shimmer animations.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() returned 38 running shimmer animations with infinite iterations and the CSS contained zero reduced-motion rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential shimmer and transition motion inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), preserving only essential state changes.

findings.summary: Page and state changes are abrupt despite browser support for View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The feature probe confirmed document.startViewTransition is available but found zero authored view-transition usage across the multi-page navigation and disclosure states.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation and a small same-document transition for the verification disclosure, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Scroll-aware chrome is implemented as static/legacy class toggling rather than declarative scroll state.
findings.evidence: CSS/DOM inspection shows a #goToTop .active class pattern and no scroll-state container query; the long content route provides a meaningful use case.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container-type: scroll-state and @container scroll-state(scrolled: top) where supported, retaining a lightweight fallback.

findings.summary: Dropdown and overlay positioning does not use anchored fallback positioning.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found zero anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try usage; dropdown containers are absolutely positioned.
findings.suggestedFix: Anchor menus to their triggers with CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks, retaining the current absolute layout as fallback.

findings.summary: The age-verification modal is a visual div, not an accessible modal, and background controls remain focusable.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no dialog, role=dialog, aria-modal, popover, or inert content, while 30 header/navigation controls behind the overlay remain keyboard-focusable.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native <dialog> opened modally, label it, trap/restore focus through platform behavior, and make the underlying page inert while open.

findings.summary: Reusable components respond only to viewport breakpoints.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found zero @container rules or container-type declarations despite cards, form controls, and header components being reused at different widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries on reusable card/header/form regions and keep viewport media queries for page-level composition.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is globally suppressed and invisible.
findings.evidence: A focus walk over visible links, inputs, buttons, and modal options reported outline none and no box shadow; authored CSS includes :focus { outline: 0 }.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the global focus reset and add a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator with sufficient offset on every interactive control.

findings.summary: Required contact fields are not programmatically required and the error is not announced.
findings.evidence: The contact form labels subject/message with *, but all controls have required=false. checkValidity() returned true on an empty form; JavaScript later inserted “Fill in fields correctly” into a generic status area.
findings.suggestedFix: Add native required constraints, aria-describedby/aria-invalid after interaction, and an aria-live or role=alert error summary that moves focus to the first invalid field.

findings.summary: Static resources lack useful cache headers.
findings.evidence: The HAR summary lists fonts and verification images among nine missing-cache-header signals; the stylesheet is parser-inserted at VeryHigh priority.
findings.suggestedFix: Set long-lived immutable caching on versioned fonts/images, keep HTML revalidated, and measure whether critical CSS should be reduced or inlined.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly disables user zoom.
findings.evidence: Both axe and Lighthouse report the meta viewport `maximum-scale=0.8, user-scalable=0`, a WCAG-critical barrier for low-vision users.
findings.suggestedFix: Use `width=device-width, initial-scale=1` and remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions.

findings.summary: Verification images omit intrinsic dimensions and one logo is delivered at the wrong density.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 5 of 6 images without width/height and one oversized image; Lighthouse also flags agego.webp as too low resolution for device density.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height to every image and provide correctly sized 1x/2x WebP/AVIF sources or srcset.

findings.summary: Public indexing signals conflict with the site’s sitemap and public routes.
findings.evidence: The homepage returns HTTP 200 and appears in a current sitemap, but sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex,nofollow and meta robots noindex,follow; Lighthouse marks it non-crawlable.
findings.suggestedFix: Decide the intended indexing policy, then align response header, meta robots, robots.txt, and sitemap. Remove noindex from pages intended for discovery.

findings.summary: Browse routes and rich previews lack route-specific metadata.
findings.evidence: The /tags/ route returned the homepage title and “Free Porn Movies” heading; homepage probes found no canonical, hreflang, Open Graph, or JSON-LD metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit unique route titles/descriptions, canonical and hreflang links, and accurate Open Graph plus appropriate schema.org metadata.

findings.summary: The CSP permits any origin plus unsafe inline script and eval, and defensive headers are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers show `default-src * data: blob: unsafe-inline unsafe-eval`, no X-Content-Type-Options, and no Permissions-Policy. HSTS and SAMEORIGIN are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based restrictive CSP in report-only mode first, then enforce it; add nosniff and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Core forms do not progressively enhance without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: The search input has no name and autocomplete=off, while contact validation relies on JavaScript even though native checkValidity reports an empty form valid; raw content itself is server-rendered.
findings.suggestedFix: Give successful controls names, use native constraints and server validation, and ensure search/contact submission and error responses work without JavaScript.

findings.summary: The site advertises a standalone web app but has no active service worker or offline fallback.
findings.evidence: site.webmanifest declares display: standalone and a start_url, but the probe found no service-worker controller or registration in the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Either complete the PWA contract with a scoped service worker and useful offline fallback, or stop advertising standalone app behavior.

findings.summary: Localized routes declare the wrong document language and provide no hreflang.
findings.evidence: On /fr/, html.lang remained `en`, dir was empty, no hreflang links existed, and the title remained English. CSS uses 24 physical left/right declarations and no logical inline properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set each locale’s correct lang, emit reciprocal hreflang links, localize route metadata, and migrate directional layout to logical properties.

findings.summary: Contact form recovery is delayed to custom JavaScript instead of native, humane validation.
findings.evidence: An empty submit produced a generic status message while native validity remained true, so errors are neither field-bound nor exposed at the moment and place of correction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required and appropriate input types, then style :user-invalid and synchronize aria-invalid plus field-specific messages only after interaction.

findings.summary: Contact inputs omit autofill hints.
findings.evidence: The name and email fields expose labels and the correct email type, but all contact controls have empty autocomplete values; search explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `autocomplete=name` and `autocomplete=email`; only disable autocomplete where there is a documented privacy/security reason.

findings.summary: Hidden and placeholder cards run continuous shimmer work even when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe observed 38 infinite shimmer animations, including underlying content hidden by the age gate; no reduced-motion or visibility pause rule exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Stop shimmer when content is hidden/offscreen and under reduced motion; prefer static placeholders and content-visibility for deferred sections.

taskList.title: Make the age gate a real accessible modal and restore visible keyboard focus
Restore user zoom and native, announced contact validation
Tighten CSP and complete defensive response headers
Correct French language metadata and localized indexing signals
Respect dark, reduced-motion, and background-work preferences
Progressively enhance search/contact and align the PWA contract
Adopt container, anchor, scroll-state, and View Transition primitives where they improve orientation
